claim_text: An NPR aggregation page published on 16 August 2026 collected same-day Indiana flooding coverage from outlets including FOX Weather, CBS News, ABC7 Chicago and WANE 15, whose headlines reported death tolls of both six and seven.
quote: At least 7 dead after historic flooding and severe storms devastate Indiana, unleash widespread destruction
confidence_justification: The aggregation itself is verifiable from the item, but it carries only headlines with no reporting of its own, so it supports the discrepancy and nothing more.
